cd /workspace/mytests && cat > t_misc.py <<'EOF'
from harness import *
import json
# empty headers_kv
d = doc(cases=[case('a', [{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{},"End_Stream":True}])],
        events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[],"end":True}])
o = chk('empty headers_kv', d, expect_error=False)
c = o['cases'][0]
print('   ', c['state'], c['frames'], c['request_frames'], c['payload_bytes'], c['sent'])
def naive(b):
    x=0
    for y in b: x=(x*257+y+1)&((1<<64)-1)
    return {'n':len(b),'h':'%016x'%x}
exp = (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'H'+(0).to_bytes(8,'big')+bytes([1])
print('    expected sent', naive(exp))
# data frame without End_Stream -> default True closes request; next frame is send_error
d = doc(cases=[case('a', [{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x"},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"y"}])])
o = chk('data default end', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']) for c in o['cases']])
# unicode escapes and utf-8 literals
d = doc(cases=[case('a', [{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"\u00e9\u4e2d","End_Stream":True}])],
        channels=[ch('c',(None,"\u00e9"))])
o = chk('unicode', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], o['channels'][0]['bytes'], naive('é'.encode()))
# headers_kv order preserved
d = doc(cases=[case('a', [{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{"z":"1","a":"2","m":"3"},"End_Stream":True}])])
o = chk('kv order', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], o['cases'][0]['sent'])
rec = (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'H'+(3).to_bytes(8,'big')
for n,v in [('z','1'),('a','2'),('m','3')]:
    rec += (1).to_bytes(8,'big')+n.encode()+(1).to_bytes(8,'big')+v.encode()
rec += bytes([1])
print('    expected', naive(rec))
# duplicate pseudo headers allowed in fuzz frames
d = doc(cases=[case('a', [{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":method","POST"]],"End_Stream":True}])])
o = chk('dup pseudo', d, expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], o['cases'][0]['flags'])
EOF
timeout 300 python3 t_misc.py
